replacements.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: a replacement transparent PNG body layer for the Potato-Me avatar editor. Image 1 is the EXACT SHAPE AND COMPOSITION reference to preserve: a distinctive naturally knobbly lumpy potato, asymmetrical crown, broad left mid-body lobe and pronounced right upper-side bulge, two short stubby legs and feet. Image 2 is the MATERIAL AND COLOR reference ONLY: muted olive gray zombie potato skin, detailed pores, earthy dark mottling, subtle fine cracks. Re-create Image 1 with the zombie skin material and colors of Image 2. Keep Image 1's silhouette, limb/foot placement, overall size, facing direction, camera and lighting as closely as possible. Preserve several obvious soft irregular potato lobes so this is unmistakably Lumpy rather than a smooth oval. Render the entire body and both feet in a 1024x1024 square, centered in the same framing as the references (body/feet occupy approximately x235 to789, y154 to922). Detailed realistic stylized 3D potato skin, tiny natural sprouts, subtle contact shadow below the feet fading into transparency. Completely blank body for compositing: NO face, NO eyes, NO eyebrows, NO mouth, NO arms, NO hands, NO clothing, NO accessories, NO text. Genuine transparent RGBA background; no checkerboard, no solid background, no outline or border. One character only.
